selection_policy: Keep the complete candidate register. Primary aggregate uses industrial-components businesses with supported normalization and positive normalized forward EBITDA and EBIT, matching this mature positive-profit target. No price or multiple cutoff.

target.forecast_period: Y1 next twelve months after T0

peers.evidence: Mature component manufacturer. The stipulated isolated relocation cost 8 and disposal gain 3 were settled before T0, with no remaining liability or earnings contribution. Reported subtotal subtracts lease expense 10; common comparison adds it back and includes the lease claim. All consolidated earnings include 100% of the subsidiary.

peers.forecast_period: Y1 next twelve months after T0
peers.evidence: Capital-intensive component manufacturer. Remove a settled disposal gain 6. The supplied consistent Y1 cycle scenario removes 30 of peak-volume/margin earnings; recurring forward depreciation is 24. A low peak-year multiple is not the normalized comparison.

peers.forecast_period: Y1 next twelve months after T0
peers.evidence: Less asset-intensive component manufacturer in a regional trough. Add lease expense 8 and settled isolated remediation cost 4; remove gain 2. Supplied demand normalization adds 10 in Y1. Normalization is a forecast condition, not observed future earnings.

peers.forecast_period: Y1 next twelve months after T0
peers.evidence: Larger component manufacturer. Added productive capacity was funded before T0 and contributes the supplied 10 of additional Y1 operating EBITDA; forward depreciation includes it. Higher multiple remains visible, with size, capital intensity and growth as comparability questions.

peers.forecast_period: Y1 next twelve months after T0

peers.forecast_period: Y1 next twelve months after T0

target_dcf.assumptions: Year-1 normalized earnings are already supported by date-0 productive capital. End-year reinvestment g/ROIC funds the following year's growth; old earnings are maintained. D&A includes leased assets, and replacement/reinvestment covers their renewal. The supplied rate and capital/claim convention are compatible; no second lease payment, interest or tax shield enters FCFF. No real tax law or observed market rate is implied.
